description: Input and output pairs for the text normalisation of docs/design/attachments.md, version 1: an implementation of its four steps maps each input to its output exactly.

vectors.name: unchanged
empty
a byte-order mark at the start is removed
only the first byte-order mark is removed
a byte-order mark after the start stays
a control character before a byte-order mark keeps it at step 1
CRLF becomes LF
a lone CR becomes LF
CR CR LF is two line breaks
control characters are removed
tab stays
C1 controls stay, NEL included
U+2028 is not a line break
leading empty lines are removed
a leading line of spaces and tabs is blank
trailing blank lines are removed
a single trailing line break is removed
trailing spaces on the last line that is not blank stay
leading spaces on the first line that is not blank stay
blank lines between lines stay
a line of U+00A0 is not blank
a line of U+3000 is not blank
only blank lines become empty
a lone line break becomes empty
a line left empty by step 3 is blank at step 4
CR line breaks with blank lines
a byte-order mark then a blank line
a byte-order mark on the second line is not at the start
U+FFFD stays
